pages.title: Seasonal Crops
pages.text: Serene Seasons lists vanilla crops by season: wheat in summer and autumn, carrots in spring and autumn, and so on. Mushrooms, nether wart and oak saplings grow year round.

pages.title: Farmer's Delight
pages.text:
Farmer's Delight adds its own season data:
- Tomato: summer
- Cabbage: autumn, winter
- Onion: spring, autumn
- Rice: summer, autumn

See [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

pages.title: Tomato Seeds
pages.text: Summer crop. Out of season it grows only slowly. A glass roof keeps a patch growing at full speed.

pages.title: Out of season
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** bone meal on an out-of-season crop is used up but works only about 1 time in 6. Save it for crops in season.\
\
Naturalist snails nearby slow crops down; keep them out of the field.

pages.title: Cabbage Seeds
pages.text: Autumn and winter crop. One of the few things you can grow in the cold.

pages.title: Fruit trees
pages.text:
Fruits Delight trees follow seasons too:
- **Spring:** pear, peach, blueberry
- **Summer:** lychee, mango, durian, lemon, pineapple
- **Autumn:** apple, orange, fig, cranberry
- **Winter:** persimmon, kiwi, hawberry

pages.title: Other mods
pages.text: Seasonal Integration adds Berry Good's sweet berries (spring, winter) and glow berries, and My Nether's Delight peppers, to year round. Fungus Delight mushrooms grow in any season.

pages.title: Pack additions
pages.text:
Some crops came with no season data and grew all year. The pack gives them their real growing seasons:
- **Coffee:** summer
- **Cassava:** summer, autumn
- **Bok choy:** spring, autumn
- **Cotton:** summer, autumn

pages.title: Berries
pages.text:
Berries and Cherries bushes and trees follow seasons, also when regrowing fruit:
- **Strawberry, cherry:** spring, summer
- **Blueberry:** summer
- **Raspberry, grapes:** summer, autumn

pages.title: Nut trees
pages.text:
Garnished nut trees grow from planted Cracked nuts:
- **Almond:** spring, summer
- **Cashew, pistachio:** summer
- **The rest:** summer, autumn

pages.title: Coffee Beans
pages.text: Summer crop. Tropical biomes (jungle, savanna, desert and similar) grow summer crops all year, so coffee, cassava and cashews do best there. Snowy biomes grow only winter crops.
